usage_note: Provider README permits free use for data analysis, research, academic work and personal applications; attribution appreciated but not required. Dataset is unofficial and not affiliated with Formula 1, FIA or any team.

data_dictionary.time: seconds from lap sample start; verified strictly increasing
data_dictionary.speed: km/h; verified min/max within plausible lap range
data_dictionary.brake: 0/1 indicator in this dataset (NOT 0/100 as in OpenF1); brake onset threshold must use > 0.5
data_dictionary.drs: provider-specific DRS indicator; not used in MVP features
data_dictionary.distance: meters, derived by provider from telemetry integration; monotonic in the checked laps
data_dictionary.DriverAhead: string 'None' used as missing marker; must not be treated as a literal driver
data_dictionary.acc_x/acc_y/acc_z: provider-computed acceleration channels; units not documented in the downloaded files and not used in MVP features

quality_checks_2026_11_21.note: Lap boundary and distance are provider-derived; alignment uncertainty across laps remains. Do not treat onset differences as causal without further evidence.

caveats: Telemetry is redistributed by a third party and was originally collected via FastF1; provenance beyond the repository is not independently verifiable.
Distance is a derived channel, not a measured channel; racing-line differences make cross-lap positional alignment approximate.
Brake is a boolean indicator, not brake pressure.
Sampling gaps up to about 1 second exist; interpolation must be bounded and gaps must be reported.
The two laps are from the same session and compound but entering speeds and tyre life context still differ; no causal claim is supported.
